identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Study of AL2846 Capsules in the Treatment of Advanced Lung Tumor and Advanced Ovarian Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multi-cohort, Randomized, Open, Multicenter Phase II Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of AL2846 Capsules in Treated Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multi-cohort, randomized, open, multicenter Phase II study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of AL2846 capsules in patients with advanced lung cancer and ovarian cancer. Objective response rate (ORR) and progression-free survival (PFS) are the primary endpoints.

armGroups.label: AL2846 capsule
armGroups.description: orally administer AL2846 capsules monotherapy, 28 days as a treatment cycle.

interventions.name: AL2846 capsule
interventions.description: AL2846 is a multi-target tyrosine kinase inhibitor.

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the percentage of subjects in complete remission (CR), partial remission (PR), and disease stability (SD).
PFS is defined as the time from randomization to the first recorded progressive disease (PD) or death from any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of subjects achieving complete response (CR) and partial response (PR).
The time from the first evaluation as CR or PR to the first evaluation as PD or death from any cause.
Time from the first administration to death from any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From baseline to the death events, assessed up to 3 years.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Occurrence of all adverse events, regardless of whether there was a causal relation with the studied drug.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From baseline to 28 days after the last dose or initiation of a new antineoplastic therapy (whichever comes first).
